delivery.existing_os_client: ES2022 ESM with fetch, WebCrypto, UTF-8, streams, AbortController and host-protected device session
delivery.native_os: common runtime plus board-specific BSP, boot, drivers, signing, update and recovery; no common universal flash image
delivery.firmware_bridge: bounded signed firmware and authorized host transport; ESM cannot execute on arbitrary MCU

billing.authority: existing account entitlement, contract, reservation and usage/invoice services

privateExecutionCore.scope: explicit OS owner local text preview; not service entitlement
privateExecutionCore.requestAuthority: host authorizer binds owner, job ID, request hash, executor, permission, zero maximum cloud charge and expiry
privateExecutionCore.nodeTransport: fixed http://127.0.0.1:11434 tags/show/chat only; reject remote model/host metadata and unsupported local format; no pull or cloud fallback
privateExecutionCore.persistence: private UID journal with exclusive lock, atomic claim, revision CAS and durable rename
privateExecutionCore.staleLock: explicit inspection/recovery required; no automatic deletion based on a PID
privateExecutionCore.lostOutcome: UNKNOWN; same ID returns saved state and never automatically repeats inference
privateExecutionCore.localityTrust: trusted local daemon metadata, not proof of network egress isolation or hardware attestation

recovery.lostMutationResponse: unknown; reconcile original job or quote before any next action

linkedExecution.scope: explicit browser-approved zero-cloud owner-local text preview
linkedExecution.persistence: existing eve_device_commands/eve_device_jobs and encrypted Eve history, shared via eve-device-replicas
linkedExecution.claimPolicy: one CAS claim; lost response/orphan claim is UNKNOWN; no automatic lease takeover
linkedExecution.recovery: same local journal and report digest, read back before acknowledgement; no repeat inference

ownerView.presenceAndReports: GET /api/eve/runtime; owner-bound devices, pending receipt states and saved executions
ownerView.selection: existing Sky/Eve URL with runtime=1 and exact model digest scheme
ownerView.credentialStorage: optional POSIX software encrypted vault, explicit process unlock; no OS biometric acceptance

objectAttachment.minimumPhysicalModule: object attachment + power/input/output as needed + authorized host transport; exact hardware is not selected

removableModule.firstHardwareCandidate: micro:bit V2 accelerometer BLE service; not yet owned or accepted
removableModule.attachmentIdentity: owner confirmation + connection nonce + object ID + mount epoch; ephemeral
removableModule.persistence: visible observation suffix in existing owner-bound Eve request/history; no new job store
removableModule.privatePreview: development opt-in and loopback /os/eve/module only; production disabled

purposeAssessment.candidateAuthority: limited lexical suggestions; owner corrects and confirms
purposeAssessment.persistence: ephemeral same-page draft; reviewed scope uses existing owner-bound Eve request/role/job
purposeAssessment.reviewHandoff: reviewSmisObjectPurpose: existing session review only, no prepare/start until explicit final confirmation

interaction.authority: existing authenticated owner workflow, permission, budget and store
